title: ForkMesh headless mirror refresh configuration
description: Secret-free local orchestration configuration. Private keys, API tokens, passwords, and wallet credentials are prohibited.

archiveDirectory.description: Owner-controlled legacy cleanup directory. New public refreshes create no archives; existing archive-*.age generations are removed after plaintext activation.

releaseStore.description: Optional owner-local content-addressed store for explicitly published immutable release assets.

ownerAliases.description: Unique public owner paths served from the same plaintext bare repository. The configured nodeOwner must be present.

mirrorUrl.description: Optional independently reachable public HTTPS Git origin. Omit to retain Tunnel-proxied Git fallback.

operations.description: The runtime additionally requires git-info-refs, git-upload-pack, tree, blob, and raw.

writableRepositoryRoot.description: Optional owner-controlled mode-0700 directory under which an authorized first push creates <owner>/<name>.git. Rendered verbatim into the gateway configuration; its presence is what allows any repository to be rendered with git-receive-pack. Omit to keep the node read-only.

writableOwners.description: Owners whose push-created repositories the refresh cycle renders from the gateway's hosted-pushes.json sidecar. Requires writableRepositoryRoot. An empty or omitted list renders no push-created repository and no git-receive-pack operation.

receiveMaxInputBytes.description: Optional receive.maxInputSize rendered as limits.receiveMaxInputBytes in the gateway configuration. Requires writableRepositoryRoot.

solana.description: Optional public self-custodial payout address; never a private key.

actionsEnabled.description: Owner-approved upper bound for this node's public Actions capability. Defaults to false; live enabled/running state additionally requires a fresh protected actions-state.json lease (same-account mode 0600 or the fixed root:gateway-group mode-0640 handoff).

reportCpu.description: Opt in to publishing a bounded aggregate host CPU percentage. Defaults to false.

reportMemory.description: Opt in to publishing bounded host memory used/total bytes. Defaults to false.

reportDisk.description: Opt in to publishing bounded used/total bytes for the filesystem containing sourceRepository. Defaults to false.

writableOwner.description: An owner name, or the single entry "*" accepting every owner the control plane authorized (a node holding website-created repositories). The wildcard may not be mixed with named owners.
